versions.text: Criterion: Verify safe, acceptable ride qualities. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within MIL-STD-1797, 5.2.1.8 Ride qualities (see tables XXIII and XXIV and figure 21 for guidance). For unmanned air vehicles ride qualities do not interfere with operation of the aircraft or accomplishment of mission tasks. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, and inspection of process, requirements, design, test, and configuration documentation.

Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Ride Qualities paragraph, unless pilot evaluation determines the air vehicle handling qualities are no worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the maximum ride discomfort index as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Ride Qualities paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the air vehicle's ride qualities as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Ride Qualities paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the air vehicle's ride qualities as specified in MIL- STD-1797, Ride Qualities paragraph for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
